# EDA 工具环境配置

本机 EDA 工具路径均已通过 `~/.bashrc` 配置，**新开 terminal 自动生效，无需手动 source**。
生成命令或脚本时直接使用下方路径，无需询问用户。

---

## 工具清单

<!-- 新增工具：在此表格追加一行 -->

| 工具 | 厂商 | 根目录变量 | 安装路径 | 版本 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VCS | Synopsys | `$VCS_HOME` | `/tools/synopsys/vcs/V-2023.12-SP2` | V-2023.12-SP2 |
| Verdi | Synopsys | `$VERDI_HOME` | `/tools/synopsys/verdi/V-2023.12-SP2` | V-2023.12-SP2 |
| Design Compiler | Synopsys | `$DC_HOME` | `/tools/synopsys/syn/U-2022.12-SP7` | U-2022.12-SP7 |
| Library Compiler | Synopsys | `$LC_HOME` | `/tools/synopsys/lc/U-2022.12-SP6` | U-2022.12-SP6 |
| SpyGlass (VC Static) | Synopsys | `$VC_STATIC_HOME` / `$SPYGLASS_HOME` | `/tools/synopsys/vc_static/T-2022.06-SP2` | T-2022.06-SP2 |
| JasperGold | Cadence | `$Jasper_ROOT` | `/tools/cadence/jasper_2025.12p002` | 2025.12p002 |
| Xcelium | Cadence | `$XLM_ROOT` | `/tools/cadence/XCELIUM2603` | 2603 |
| vManager | Cadence | `$VMANAGER_HOME` | `/tools/cadence/VMANAGER2209` | 2209 |

---

## 关键环境变量

<!-- 新增工具：在对应厂商分组下追加 export 块 -->

```bash
# [Synopsys] VCS
VCS_HOME=/tools/synopsys/vcs/V-2023.12-SP2

# [Synopsys] Verdi
VERDI_HOME=/tools/synopsys/verdi/V-2023.12-SP2
NOVAS_HOME=$VERDI_HOME

# [Synopsys] Design Compiler
DC_HOME=/tools/synopsys/syn/U-2022.12-SP7

# [Synopsys] Library Compiler（.lib → .db 编译）
LC_HOME=/tools/synopsys/lc/U-2022.12-SP6

# [Synopsys] SpyGlass / VC Static
VC_STATIC_HOME=/tools/synopsys/vc_static/T-2022.06-SP2
SPYGLASS_HOME=$VC_STATIC_HOME

# [Synopsys] License
LM_LICENSE_FILE=5280@workstation
SNPSLMD_LICENSE_FILE=2700@workstation

# [Cadence] JasperGold
Jasper_ROOT=/tools/cadence/jasper_2025.12p002

# [Cadence] Xcelium
XLM_ROOT=/tools/cadence/XCELIUM2603
CDS_INST_DIR=$XLM_ROOT

# [Cadence] vManager（覆盖率/回归管理；MDV 复用 Xcelium）
VMANAGER_HOME=/tools/cadence/VMANAGER2209
MDV_XLM_HOME=$XLM_ROOT

# 新工具在此追加 ↓
```

---

## 各工具典型调用

<!-- 新增工具：在此追加 ### 小节 -->

### VCS
```bash
vcs -full64 -sverilog -timescale=1ns/1ps \
    +incdir+./rtl ./rtl/top.sv ./tb/tb_top.sv \
    -o simv
./simv +UVM_TESTNAME=base_test
```

### Verdi
```bash
verdi -sv -ssf dump.fsdb &
verdi -sv -vcf dump.vcd &
```

### Design Compiler
```bash
dc_shell -f syn/run_dc.tcl
```

### Library Compiler
```bash
# 编译 .lib → .db（DC 读 .db 综合所需）
lc_shell -f syn/compile_lib.tcl
# 或交互式：read_lib xxx.lib; write_lib xxx -format db -output xxx.db
```

### SpyGlass (VC Static)
```bash
spyglass -tcl sg/run_lint.tcl
```

### JasperGold
```bash
jg -no_gui jg/run_fpv.tcl
jg jg/run_fpv.tcl            # 带 GUI
```

#### Codex 专用：license-server sandbox 规则

> 本小节**只适用于 Codex 且执行工具带 sandbox/approval 边界的环境**。
> Claude Code、普通 shell 和 CI 继续使用上面的标准命令；不要仅因为这段
> Codex 兼容规则而给 Claude Code 增加额外包装或授权步骤。

JasperGold 启动时必须通过 TCP 访问 `5280@workstation`。Codex 的普通
sandbox 可能禁止该 socket，并把连接失败笼统显示为
`INFO: Waiting for license`。这不等于许可证数量不足。

**Codex 启动规则（必须遵守）：**

1. 让 `jg -no_gui` 成为执行命令的直接入口，并使用已批准的直接命令前缀；
   如果该前缀未获批准，首次启动就显式请求 unsandboxed/escalated execution。
2. 不要把 `jg` 隐藏在 `env`、`/usr/bin/time`、`bash -lc`、`sh -c`、
   `timeout`、`set ...;`、命令替换、重定向或管道后面。复合 shell 命令会被
   拆成多个权限片段，内层 `jg` 不保证继承 license-server 网络权限。
3. 不要为保存日志写 `jg ... 2>&1 | tee ...`。直接指定 `-proj`，使用 Jasper
   自动生成的 `<proj>/jg_console.log` 和
   `<proj>/sessionLogs/session_*/jg_session_*.log`。
4. 若必须生成 `/usr/bin/time` 文件或额外 tee 日志，把完整流程放进一个明确的
   wrapper script，并对该 wrapper 整体使用已批准前缀或显式 escalated
   execution。不要依赖 wrapper 内某个子命令碰巧获批。
5. `CDS_LIC_FILE` 已由 shell 环境设置。不要为了重复设置它而将正常的直接
   `jg` 调用改写成 `env CDS_LIC_FILE=... jg ...`。

推荐的 Codex 命令形态：

```bash
jg -no_gui -proj /absolute/arm/run/jgproject -tcl /absolute/arm/run.tcl
```

**Codex license 诊断命令：** 正常的直接授权启动无需每次先查询 license；
启动 watchdog 失败后必须使用下面的 `lmutil lmstat`，并通过已批准或显式
escalated 的环境执行。不要用受限 sandbox 内裸跑失败的 `lmstat` 推断
server 状态。

```bash
lmutil lmstat -f jasper_interactive -c 5280@workstation
lmutil lmstat -f jasper_fpv         -c 5280@workstation
```

**Codex JasperGold 启动 watchdog：** 按以下状态机执行；它用于防止 Codex
卡在 license 连接阶段，不用于判断许可证数量是否充足。

1. 用直接批准的 `jg -no_gui` 或显式 unsandboxed/escalated execution 启动，
   并观察启动后的前 10 秒输出。
2. 若 stdout/stderr 出现子串 `successfully checked out licenses`，启动通过，
   继续分析或证明。匹配该子串，不要绑定完整行、引号或 feature 顺序，以兼容
   Jasper 版本间的日志格式差异。典型成功行是：

```text
INFO: successfully checked out licenses "jasper_interactive" and "jasper_fpv".
```

3. 若 10 秒内没有该子串，无论输出是 `Waiting for license` 还是完全静默，
   都立即停止进程；不要把它计作有效 Jasper 证明运行。
4. 用上面的 `lmutil lmstat -f` 检查两个 feature，并检查
   `/tmp/cds.license.log` 的当前时间窗口：
   - 有 `DENIED`：调查 feature、数量、版本或 license policy；
   - 有 `OUT`：checkout 已到 server，调查次级 feature 或客户端启动；
   - 没有任何对应请求且 license 有空闲：判定为 Codex sandbox/网络权限问题，
     用显式 unsandboxed/escalated execution 重跑一次。
5. 授权重跑仍应用一次 10 秒 watchdog；若仍未通过，停止并报告环境故障。
   最多重跑一次，不要无限重试。

将 license 启动阶段的总等待控制在约 20–30 秒以内（包含一次诊断和一次授权
重跑），**禁止等待 180–240 秒**。

除非 daemon 确认宕机且用户明确授权，不要自动启动或重启 license server。

### Xcelium
```bash
xrun -64bit -sv \
     +incdir+./rtl ./rtl/top.sv ./tb/tb_top.sv \
     -top tb_top -timescale 1ns/1ps
```

### vManager（覆盖率合并 / 回归管理）
```bash
vmanager &                       # GUI
vmanager -batch -execcmd <cmd>   # 批处理
# MDV 流程复用 Xcelium：$MDV_XLM_HOME = $XLM_ROOT
```

### License Server
```bash
# Cadence
cadence_lmgrd   # alias: /tools/cadence/ocad/tools/licsrv/bin/bin.cds/lmgrd -c .../cds.license.dat -l /tmp/cds.license.log
lmstat -a -c 5280@workstation

# Synopsys
synopsys_lmgrd  # alias: /tools/cadence/ocad/tools/licsrv/bin/bin.syn/lmgrd -c .../syn.license.dat -l /tmp/syn.license.log
lmstat -a -c 2700@workstation
```

---

## 注意事项

- VCS 必须加 `-full64`
- Verdi `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 已同时配置 IUS 和 VCS 的 PLI 路径（`$VERDI_HOME/share/PLI/IUS/LINUX64` 和 `$VERDI_HOME/share/PLI/VCS/LINUX64`）
- Library Compiler (`lc_shell`) 已安装，可将 `.lib` 编译成 DC 综合所需的 `.db`
- JasperGold 使用 `CDS_LIC_FILE=5280@workstation`
- Synopsys license 端口：2700@workstation；Cadence license 端口：5280@workstation
- 共享目录：`/mnt/hgfs/sharefolder/`（VMware Shared Folder）

## 新增工具时的扩展步骤

在 `.bashrc` 新增工具后，按顺序改这个文件的四处地方：

**1. frontmatter description** — 在工具二进制名列表末尾追加：
```
... lmstat, <新工具的可执行文件名>
```

**2. 工具清单表格** — 追加一行：
```
| 工具名 | 厂商 | `$NEW_TOOL_HOME` | `/tools/vendor/path` | 版本 |
```

**3. 关键环境变量** — 在对应厂商分组下追加：
```bash
# [厂商] 工具名
NEW_TOOL_HOME=/tools/vendor/toolname_version
NEW_TOOL_LICENSE_FILE=...   # 如有独立 license
```

**4. 典型调用小节** — 追加：
```bash
### 工具名
<binary> <常用参数>
```

     8	 *  
     9	 * Info: Generated N-to-M crossbar.
    10	 *       This module has been developed to be used in the DMA subsystem, in which it is not possible to use an NtoM crossbar.
    11	 *       The problem is that each slave port of the DMA xbar is actually a master port of the system bus. The DMA xbar slave ports 
    12	 *       cannot be indexed by the master's request address because they all perform the same function, they all can read/write 
    13	 *       to/from the same memory spaces.
    14	 *       This module is a workaround to this problem, as it is composed by a number of N-to-1 crossbars, each for a different slave
    15	 *       (which would be a system bus master port).
    16	 *       The amount of masters per crossbar is defined by the parameter NUM_MASTERS_PER_XBAR.
    17	 *       It is thus possible, from an application point of view, to use channels that are guaranteed to have a dedicated master port,
    18	 *       reducing the need for additional arbitration logic.
    19	 */
    20	
    21	module dma_NtoM_xbar #(
    22	    parameter int unsigned XBAR_NMASTER = 4,
    23	    parameter int unsigned XBAR_MSLAVE = 2,
    24	    // OBI data types
    25	    parameter type obi_req_t = xheep_obi_pkg::xheep_obi_req_t,
    26	    parameter type obi_rsp_t = xheep_obi_pkg::xheep_obi_rsp_t
    27	) (
    28	    input logic clk_i,
    29	    input logic rst_ni,
    30	
    31	    // Master ports
    32	    input  obi_req_t [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0] master_req_i,
    33	    output obi_rsp_t [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0] master_resp_o,
    34	
    35	    // slave ports
    36	    output obi_req_t [XBAR_MSLAVE-1:0] slave_req_o,
    37	    input  obi_rsp_t [XBAR_MSLAVE-1:0] slave_resp_i
    38	);
    39	  import core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::*;
    40	
    41	  /* Generation of the crossbars */
    42	  generate
    43	    xbar_varlat_n_to_one #(
    44	        .XBAR_NMASTER(core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[0]),
    45	        .obi_req_t(obi_req_t),
    46	        .obi_rsp_t(obi_rsp_t)
    47	    ) xbar_i (
    48	        .clk_i(clk_i),
    49	        .rst_ni(rst_ni),
    50	        .master_req_i(master_req_i[core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[0]-1:0]),
    51	        .master_resp_o(master_resp_o[core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[0]-1:0]),
    52	        .slave_req_o(slave_req_o[0]),
    53	        .slave_resp_i(slave_resp_i[0])
    54	    );
    55	
    56	    for (genvar i = 1; i < XBAR_MSLAVE; i++) begin : gen_xbar
    57	      if (core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i] == 1) begin : gen_xbar_single_channel
    58	        assign slave_req_o[i] = master_req_i[i+core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[0]-1];
    59	        assign master_resp_o[i+core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[0]-1] = slave_resp_i[i];
    60	      end else begin : gen_xbar_multi_channel
    61	        xbar_varlat_n_to_one #(
    62	            .XBAR_NMASTER(core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i]),
    63	            .obi_req_t(obi_req_t),
    64	            .obi_rsp_t(obi_rsp_t)
    65	        ) xbar_i (
    66	            .clk_i(clk_i),
    67	            .rst_ni(rst_ni),
    68	            .master_req_i(master_req_i[core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i] + core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i-1]-1:core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i-1]]),
    69	            .master_resp_o(master_resp_o[core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i] + core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i-1]-1:core_v_mini_mcu_pkg::DMA_XBAR_MASTERS[i-1]]),
    70	            .slave_req_o(slave_req_o[i]),
    71	            .slave_resp_i(slave_resp_i[i])
    72	        );

35	  localparam int unsigned ReqDataWidth = 32'd1 + 32'd4 + 32'd32 + 32'd32;
    36	  // Response width: rdata[31:0]
    37	  localparam int unsigned RspDataWidth = 32'd32;
    38	
    39	  // INTERNAL SIGNALS
    40	  // ----------------
    41	  // Crossbar input and output data
    42	  logic [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0]                   master_xbar_req_req;
    43	  logic [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0]                   xbar_master_rsp_gnt;
    44	  logic [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0]                   xbar_master_rsp_rvalid;
    45	  logic [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0][ReqDataWidth-1:0] master_xbar_req_data;
    46	  logic [XBAR_NMASTER-1:0][RspDataWidth-1:0] xbar_master_rsp_data;
    47	  logic [             0:0]                   xbar_slave_req_req;
    48	  logic [             0:0]                   slave_xbar_rsp_gnt;
    49	  logic [             0:0]                   slave_xbar_rsp_rvalid;
    50	  logic [             0:0][ReqDataWidth-1:0] xbar_slave_req_data;
    51	  logic [             0:0][RspDataWidth-1:0] slave_xbar_rsp_data;
    52	  logic xbar_slave_req_req_outstanding, slave_xbar_rsp_gnt_outstanding;
    53	
    54	  // --------
    55	  // CROSSBAR
    56	  // --------
    57	  // Unroll OBI master signals
    58	  generate
    59	    for (genvar i = 0; unsigned'(i) < XBAR_NMASTER; i++) begin : gen_master_unroll
    60	      assign master_xbar_req_req[i] = master_req_i[i].req;
    61	      assign master_xbar_req_data[i] = {
    62	        master_req_i[i].we, master_req_i[i].be, master_req_i[i].addr, master_req_i[i].wdata
    63	      };
    64	      assign master_resp_o[i] = '{
    65	              gnt: xbar_master_rsp_gnt[i],
    66	              rvalid: xbar_master_rsp_rvalid[i],
    67	              rdata: xbar_master_rsp_data[i]
    68	          };
    69	    end
    70	  endgenerate
    71	
    72	  // Unroll OBI slave signals
    73	  assign slave_req_o.req = xbar_slave_req_req_outstanding;
    74	  assign {
    75	    slave_req_o.we,
    76	    slave_req_o.be,
    77	    slave_req_o.addr,
    78	    slave_req_o.wdata
    79	  } = xbar_slave_req_data[0];
    80	  assign {slave_xbar_rsp_gnt[0], slave_xbar_rsp_rvalid[0], slave_xbar_rsp_data[0]} = slave_resp_i;
    81	
    82	  // Instantiate crossbar
    83	  xbar_varlat #(
    84	      .AggregateGnt(32'd0),  // all the masters from X-HEEP do not aggregate multiple masters
    85	      .NumIn(XBAR_NMASTER),
    86	      .NumOut(32'd1),
    87	      .ReqDataWidth(ReqDataWidth),
    88	      .RespDataWidth(RspDataWidth),
    89	      .ExtPrio(1'b0)  // do not use external arbiter priority
    90	  ) u_xbar_varlat (

    92	      .rst_ni (rst_ni),
    93	      .rr_i   ('0),
    94	      .req_i  (master_xbar_req_req),
    95	      .add_i  ('0),
    96	      .wdata_i(master_xbar_req_data),
    97	      .gnt_o  (xbar_master_rsp_gnt),
    98	      .vld_o  (xbar_master_rsp_rvalid),
    99	      .rdata_o(xbar_master_rsp_data),
   100	      .gnt_i  (slave_xbar_rsp_gnt_outstanding),
   101	      .req_o  (xbar_slave_req_req),
   102	      .vld_i  (slave_xbar_rsp_rvalid),
   103	      .wdata_o(xbar_slave_req_data),
   104	      .rdata_i(slave_xbar_rsp_data)
   105	  );
   106	
   107	  //block outstanding transactions
   108	  typedef enum logic {
   109	    OUTSTANDING_REQ,
   110	    OUTSTANDING_WAITFOR_VALID
   111	  } outstanding_req_fsm_e;
   112	
   113	  outstanding_req_fsm_e state_n, state_q;
   114	
   115	  /* block outstanding transactions
   116	    The Master M1 may get a GNT at cycle 1, then the Master M2
   117	    gets a GNT at cycle 2 (from the same or different slaves)
   118	    As outstanding transactions are not supported (neither in-order nor out-of-order)
   119	    we need to block the transaction.
   120	
   121	    The addr_dec_resp_mux_varlat gates the second request of a master until the valid of the first request returns
   122	    However, when different masters collides into the 1toM bus, the second part of the xbar sees a single master (the neck) issueing multiple requests (although
   123	    these 2 reqeusts can actually come from 2 different masters M1 and M2)
   124	    The second neck.req is gated by the addr_dec_resp_mux_varlat, but not its grant, thus the following FSM gates the gnt as the original master (i.e. the one before the neck)
   125	    The reason why we have to gate the grant is that the M2 issued a request, although the neck.req is gated by the valid of the M1 request, the grant is propagated
   126	    to M2, which gets its request granted without begin correct.
   127	  */
   128	  always_comb begin
   129	    state_n = state_q;
   130	    xbar_slave_req_req_outstanding = xbar_slave_req_req[0];
   131	    slave_xbar_rsp_gnt_outstanding = slave_xbar_rsp_gnt[0];
   132	
   133	    case (state_q)
   134	
   135	      OUTSTANDING_REQ: begin
   136	        if (xbar_slave_req_req_outstanding && slave_xbar_rsp_gnt_outstanding) begin
   137	          state_n = OUTSTANDING_WAITFOR_VALID;
   138	        end
   139	      end
   140	
   141	      OUTSTANDING_WAITFOR_VALID: begin
   142	        xbar_slave_req_req_outstanding = 1'b0;
   143	        slave_xbar_rsp_gnt_outstanding = 1'b0;

   148	            state_n = OUTSTANDING_WAITFOR_VALID;
   149	          end else begin
   150	            state_n = OUTSTANDING_REQ;
   151	          end
   152	        end
   153	      end
   154	    endcase
